description: Visual cover & thumbnail RAG knowledge base derived from Driftpost brand Instagram grid references and category best practices.
universal_rules: Never pick blurry, mid-transition, dark/underexposed, black/blank, or mid-blink/awkward mouth-open frames.
Ensure the main subject (person, garment, jewellery, car, or product) is upright, well-lit, unobstructed, and centered inside both 4:5 / 9:16 Instagram grid crops and 16:9 YouTube thumbnails.
Never default to frame index 0 unless it genuinely scores highest on visual hook, sharpness, and brand fit.

When a frame has an intentional, clean, high-contrast title/hook overlay that matches the brand's Instagram grid style (without covering the hero subject's face or product), score it higher than plain mid-speech frames.

luxury_bridal_editorial.cover_style: Clean, editorial, luxury boutique aesthetic. Prefer warm, rich lighting, crisp hero bridal garment or storefront/logo reveal, or candid designer/client moment. Reject cluttered or loud promotional sticker banners.
priority_signals: Hero bridal lehenga/couture outfit in sharp focus
Clean luxury storefront, logo, or brand reveal card
Candid warm interaction or confident designer/bride portrait

ethnic_fashion_showcase.cover_style: Crisp outfit-first showcase. Prefer a well-lit full or mid-shot of the model/presenter wearing or holding the featured saree, kurta, sherwani, or suit clearly so embroidery, drape, and colour pop. Minimal or clean small branding only.
priority_signals: Presenter or model facing camera clearly displaying the outfit
Vibrant fabric texture and silhouette unobstructed
Clean showroom/studio background
avoid: Extreme close-ups that hide the garment silhouette

family_apparel_retail.cover_style: Engaging retail showroom hook. Prefer a bright, well-lit frame with a smiling presenter or customer holding/wearing the featured item; if a sharp frame has a clean top/bottom hook headline or store-name banner (like 'Special Offer', 'Family Store', or occasion callout) without blocking faces, prefer it.
priority_signals: Smiling customer or presenter in bright store aisles
Featured garment/footwear clearly visible in hand or worn
Clean readable hook banner at top/bottom if present
avoid: Empty racks without a focal point

jewellery_showroom.cover_style: High-trust bright showroom hook. Prefer crisp, well-lit frames showing either a smiling presenter/customer with the jewellery piece clearly visible OR a clean, bold, readable top headline/offer badge (e.g. Gold Rate, EMI, Lightweight Collection, Customer Smile) paired with an unobstructed smiling face and showroom display.
priority_signals: Sparkling necklace/ring/bangle or tray clearly visible in bright lighting
Confident, smiling presenter or happy customer
Bold readable top headline/offer badge if part of the video's hook

salon_beauty_wellness.cover_style: Clean transformation & glow aesthetic. Prefer the finished 'after' hair color/styling, glowing skin, nail art, or bridal makeup reveal with the client or stylist facing camera in soft, flattering light — or a clean, modern salon interior / minimal text title card. Avoid messy mid-wash, foil, or towel-prep frames unless no reveal exists.
priority_signals: Finished hair/skin/makeup/nail transformation reveal in sharp focus
Clean portrait of smiling client or stylist in bright modern salon
Minimal, refined text overlay or clean service title card

automotive_dealership.cover_style: High-clarity inventory hook. Prefer a sharp 3/4 front exterior shot of the car with the presenter standing cleanly beside it (never blocking the car's grille/body). If a frame includes clean, readable year/price/availability/spec callout text without hiding the car, score it highest.
priority_signals: Full front or 3/4 exterior view of the vehicle in crisp daylight/showroom light
Presenter standing beside the car looking at camera
Readable spec/price/year badge if present

food_bakery_hospitality.cover_style: Appetizing or inviting hero reveal. Prefer vibrant, sharp close-ups of the hero cake, dish, dryfruit gift hamper, or scenic resort pool/cottage exterior in natural or warm lighting.
priority_signals: Hero food/cake/gift box centered in vibrant lighting
Scenic resort property/pool/room wide shot with clean horizon
Warm smiling host or chef presenting the item

furniture_interiors.cover_style: Craftsmanship & space showcase. Prefer a sharp, level wide/medium shot of the hero sofa, bed, mandir, or finished interior room with balanced warm lighting and clean lines.
priority_signals: Complete furniture piece or finished room clearly framed
Rich wood/fabric/finish detail in sharp focus
Level verticals and clean uncluttered floor/background

fitness_education_healthcare_services.cover_style: Credible, high-trust focal shot. Prefer a confident, smiling coach, educator, doctor, speaker, or founder looking toward the camera, or a sharp hero product/bottle/campus shot with clean framing.
priority_signals: Confident eye-contact portrait with warm/authoritative expression
Action shot in clean gym/classroom/clinic/stage setting
Sharp hero product (e.g. perfume bottle) with clean background

almas_bridal_gallery.grid_notes: Refined luxury bridal boutique grid: warm editorial shots, hanging bridal lehengas, storefront/logo arrival graphics, and candid boutique fittings. Never choose noisy discount-style frames.

cotton_plus.grid_notes: Bright family garment store grid: smiling customers/staff in store aisles with clean top hook headline and Cotton Plus Family Store branding.

kanchanmala_chembur.grid_notes: High-energy jewellery showroom grid: smiling presenter/customers in bright showroom with bold readable gold/red top hook banners (Gold Rate, EMI, Lightweight Jewellery, Customer Smile).

zivara_salon.grid_notes: Modern clean salon grid: hair transformation reveals, AI skin analysis demos, sleek salon interior, and refined minimal offer/greeting typography.

roopali_saree.grid_notes: Clean ethnic fashion grid: crisp saree, lehenga, and designer blouse showcases on model or presenter with clean minimal overlay and vibrant fabric detail.

zam_zam_motors.grid_notes: Pre-owned car dealership grid: clean 3/4 exterior car shot with presenter beside the vehicle and clear year/price/availability badge.
